column1: # Users and groups host/create_usersgroups.sh creates on the Host, in this order.
# Fields are separated by whitespace; '#' starts a comment.
# Users get no password, home or login shell, and no SMB access.
# Names use letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-'; they are passed to cli as quoted strings.
# One group, media, is every media Service user's primary group; access inside a Library tree
# comes from it (docs/research/0552-unix-identities.md). One user per media app Service, for
# attribution. Rename books (4008) to cwa in the TrueNAS UI before running the script.
# The no-login owner of files people added over SMB before #543; no Service runs as it.
